scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: AWS sustains >33% growth as AI demand exceeds capacity through 2028
Capex peaks in 2027, FCF inflects positive by mid-2027
Advertising margins expand, contributing $20B+ in operating income
Fed begins cutting rates, expanding tech multiples

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: AWS growth normalizes to 28-32% as base grows larger
Capex continues at $220B+ but operating margins hold at 13-14%
FCF remains negative or minimal through 2027 but no crisis
Fed on hold; multiples stable at current levels

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: AI digestion cycle — enterprise customers slow cloud migration
Open-source models commoditize inference, pressuring AWS pricing
Depreciation wave from $220B+ capex compresses margins to 10-11%
FTC trial overhang + potential structural remedy
Another hyperscaler signals demand saturation by cutting capex
